tagline: 2026 Computer Science Engineering graduate focused on Java, full-stack development, and AI/ML systems.
description: Aspiring Software Developer from Bengaluru with hands-on academic and internship experience across Java, web development, databases, AI/ML, and NLP projects.

roles.detailed: Java Developer • Full-Stack Developer • AI/ML Enthusiast

bio: I am a 2026 Computer Science and Engineering graduate from Vivekananda Institute of Technology, VTU, Bengaluru. My work spans Java, Python, JavaScript, React, Next.js, MySQL, DBMS, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and NLP. Through internships and engineering projects, I have built production-ready applications such as booking systems, test case managers, digital payment workflows, speech emotion analysis, skincare recommendation systems, and conversational AI tools. I am looking for entry-level Software Developer, Java Developer, Full-Stack Developer, and AI/ML Engineer roles where I can contribute, learn quickly, and build reliable software products.

certifications.title: Java Full Stack with React JS & AI

Practiced professional requirements analysis, database indexing, testing, and sprint progress presentations.

bullets: Assisted engineering team with software development, debugging, unit testing, and modular application feature enhancements.

experience.desc: Gained applied experience in production-grade software engineering, collaborative debugging, structured code maintenance, and agile delivery.

projects.title: TestTrack Pro
projects.subtitle: Full-stack test case management and bug tracking system
projects.problem: QA and engineering teams need an organized system to author test cases, record execution outcomes, and track defect lifecycles without spreadsheet overhead.
projects.solution: Developed TestTrack Pro as a full-stack web application featuring test suite management, execution status tracking, bug reporting, and interactive dashboard analytics.
projects.challenge: Structuring complex relational test execution states, nested test suites, and dynamic status updates in a responsive web UI.
projects.learning: Strengthened full-stack state management, REST API architecture, test engineering principles, and production deployment on Vercel.
projects.desc: A full-stack test suite and defect management platform designed for QA engineers and developers to streamline testing cycles, log issues, and monitor quality metrics.

projects.title: BTMS (BHEL Taxi System)
projects.subtitle: Enterprise employee transportation booking platform
projects.problem: Manual taxi request coordination for corporate personnel creates scheduling bottlenecks and lacks centralized auditing.
projects.solution: Built the BTMS platform allowing employees to book transportation, track approval states, and assist dispatchers in managing driver assignments.
projects.challenge: Designing structured database schemas with relational constraints for bookings, locations, drivers, and approval timestamps.
projects.learning: Deepened Java backend development skills, relational database design, query optimization, and enterprise software reliability.
projects.desc: A production-oriented transportation management system built during the BHEL internship to automate taxi booking workflows, driver allocations, and trip logs.

projects.title: YM-Pay
projects.subtitle: Digital transaction and payment workflow platform
projects.problem: Financial transaction interfaces require strict input validation, clear feedback states, and reliable ledger record management.
projects.solution: Developed YM-Pay as a web-based payment simulation platform with user authentication, wallet transaction entry, and real-time history logs.
projects.challenge: Managing consistent state across user balances, transaction history entries, and secure authentication flows.
projects.learning: Mastered full-stack form validation, transaction state handling, and secure web application patterns.
projects.desc: A digital payment workflow platform featuring authentication-protected user accounts, instant funds transfers, and comprehensive transaction ledgers.

projects.title: VakCare
projects.subtitle: AI-assisted clinical support and healthcare consultation prototype
projects.problem: Healthcare consultations need accessible triage tools to help patients describe symptoms and access appropriate health resources quickly.
projects.solution: Collaborated on VakCare, an AI-powered healthcare assistant prototype built during the 48-hour Shristi Hackathon at Acharya Institute of Technology.
projects.challenge: Rapidly designing an intuitive patient intake flow, integrating AI-assisted guidance, and deploying a functional MVP within 48 hours.
projects.learning: Excelled in fast-paced hackathon teamwork, high-velocity frontend development, and delivering demonstrable software under tight deadlines.
projects.desc: An AI-powered healthcare triage and consultation prototype engineered during the 48-hour Shristi Hackathon to provide accessible patient support workflows.

projects.title: Eco_Skin
projects.subtitle: AI-driven personalized skincare recommendation system
projects.problem: Generic skincare advice fails to account for individual skin types, environmental conditions, and sensitive ingredients.
projects.solution: Built an intelligent recommendation system that processes individual skin attributes and generates customized product and routine suggestions.
projects.challenge: Formulating transparent, rule-assisted ML recommendation logic that provides explainable suggestions to non-technical users.
projects.learning: Applied machine learning concepts to real-world consumer wellness data, data cleaning, and recommendation pipelines.
projects.desc: An AI-driven skincare advisor combining Python, machine learning algorithms, and structured concern mapping to generate personalized skincare routines.

projects.title: Speech Emotion Analyser
projects.subtitle: Audio signal processing & acoustic emotion classification
projects.problem: Automated sentiment analysis traditionally relies on text, missing acoustic emotional cues present in voice tone and pitch.
projects.solution: Engineered an audio classification pipeline that extracts acoustic features (MFCCs, pitch, energy) from speech samples to predict emotional states.
projects.challenge: Handling audio noise variations, normalizing diverse speaker frequencies, and evaluating multi-class classification accuracy.
projects.learning: Gained deep experience in audio digital signal preprocessing, feature extraction pipelines, and model evaluation metrics.
projects.desc: A machine learning system that classifies emotional nuances from human speech audio samples using audio feature extraction and predictive classifiers.

projects.title: Multilingual News Summarizer
projects.subtitle: NLP pipeline for concise multilingual news summarization & translation
projects.problem: Cross-lingual news consumption is hindered by lengthy articles and language barriers.
projects.solution: Designed an NLP pipeline that extracts salient content from long-form news articles and translates concise summaries into target languages.
projects.challenge: Maintaining semantic integrity and readability across summarization and translation phases.
projects.learning: Explored NLP preprocessing, text tokenization, abstractive/extractive summarization, and translation evaluation.
projects.desc: An NLP system that summarizes long-form news articles and provides accurate multilingual translations for fast, accessible information consumption.

projects.title: Conversational Memory Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Context-aware AI tutor with multi-turn conversation memory
projects.problem: Stateless chatbots lose context between questions, forcing students to repeatedly re-explain prior steps during homework study.
projects.solution: Developed a conversational AI study assistant that maintains multi-turn memory buffers to provide context-aware homework guidance.
projects.challenge: Managing context window boundaries and prompt state without hallucinating prior conversation details.
projects.learning: Deepened understanding of conversational state management, prompt engineering, and educational AI design principles.
projects.desc: A conversational AI chatbot equipped with persistent session memory to assist students with step-by-step problem solving and interactive learning.
